firstContext: This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Something moves out there — The Rerun.
👁️ Nathan freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Nathan: "Huh. Never been this way before."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/10/5), with 5 wave-4 fought, 5 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 6 · Craft 8 · Talk 13 · Explore 32 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
